name: Plettenberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Plettenberg (a yellow castle with a chequy shield on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Plettenberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Plettenberg arms — castle with chequy shield on blue
